_comment: Source of truth for voice-to-tasks assignee matching. Loaded fresh on every extraction request — no deploy needed to edit it (just save the file; if your Render plan has no Shell access to edit the live file directly, editing here and pushing a normal deploy works the same, just isn't instant). 'email' must match an existing account's email in Служители/Employees for the AI's guess to auto-resolve to a real person — leave it blank if that person has no account yet, or if you'd rather always pick them manually on the review screen.
